conviction_note: The Q1 numbers probably beat the bar: June monthly DAU was a record 400m, July and August stayed high, and the yen averaged about 159-160 against 146 a year ago and 150 in the plan. But this name sold off on its last Q1 'surprise' (-9.9%, the bad-news-is-out reaction) and carries a 6.21x margin-long overhang. Weathernews has not revised its full-year guide at a Q1 print since FY25, and it announced its recent shareholder returns at H1 and Q3. So the findings sum to +0.3 and the scaled number is +0.1 (p_up 51 on a 5.0 scale): the fundamental read leans up and the reaction function cancels most of it.
bar: No quarterly consensus. Bar = Q1 operating profit of ~985m yen, from the Q1 FY26 progress rate (17.4%, OP 912m: https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=4825&mode=k) applied to the IFIS full-year consensus of 5,656m OP / 5,749m ordinary (company plan 5,400 / 5,500): https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=4825 (as of 2026-10-07). The street already sits above the company plan. A single consensus source plus own-history arithmetic, so every size here is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.58% of shares from one seller (0.60% before, -0.02pt, covering slightly), as of 2026-09-29 per the baseline (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). Margin ratio (信用倍率) 6.21x on kabutan 2026-10-08 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4825), so leveraged retail is crowded long. Run-up -4.31% over 20 days and -1.01% over 5. No option skew exists. The baseline's priced_lean is +0.21: squeeze +0.35 and run-up +0.22 against margin overhang -0.40.

findings.finding: The company's own release says monthly cumulative app DAU hit a record 400m in June 2026 and stayed high through July and August. That is about +38% on FY26's average month (3.5bn a year). It should feed Internet Domain ad and subscription revenue (about 35% of sales, 2,251m in Q1 FY26) in a seasonally peak quarter, with JMA confirming typhoons and record rain on the Pacific side of East Japan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY26 (2025-10-08): ordinary profit 2.4x year on year, flagged by kabutan as a surprise; the stock fell about 9.9% the next day on 'bad news is out' / profit-taking (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4825&nmode=0&date=20251000). Internet Domain revenue missed plan slightly in FY26 on falling carrier revenue.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: it is a public TDnet release. But no monthly DAU figure was given for July or August, ad revenue per DAU is not disclosed, and the stock has drifted from ~2,015 to 1,953 since early September. If the market had priced a strong Internet quarter, the stock would not be at a 20-day low going into the print.
findings.independence: JMA summer 2026 summary: heavy rain on the Pacific side of East Japan from typhoons 6/7/8/15 and the August Chiba downpour, plus record heat in West Japan (https://www.data.jma.go.jp/cpd/longfcst/seasonal/202608/202608s.html). Different source, same direction, but it is the weather driver behind the same DAU fact.

findings.finding: USD/JPY averaged about 159-160 in Jun-Aug 2026 (month-ends 160.2 / 160.1 / 157.4) against 146.33 in Q1 FY26 and the plan's 150. That lifts the yen value of Sea Domain revenue (65% global; Q4 FY26 Sea +10.5% yoy at a 158.8 rate) and leaves room against the plan. Against that, the yen firmed from 161.9 at the end of May to 157.4 at the end of August, which may cost a small non-operating FX loss in ordinary profit, the line kabutan's headline uses.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q4 FY26 at 158.8 yen: Sea +10.5%, OP +6.4%; the FY print (2026-07-09) still fell about 4.3% because the new-year guide was only +3% OP (kabutan 2026-07-10 articles, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4825&page=4).
findings.why_not_priced: Macro-to-company transmission, so treat it as a hypothesis. The plan assumes 150 yen (tanshin p.4) and the street's 5,656 OP may already include FX. The size is kept small for that reason.
findings.independence: Company FY26 presentation: quarterly FX and Sea Domain revenue, Q4 +10.5% at 158.8 yen (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260708589833.pdf).

findings.finding: No summer 2026 TV commercial campaign appears in the company's releases: the June 2026 push was four AI-generated video ads. In 2022-2024 a June national TV campaign took Q1 margin to 7.8% (FY25), and cutting it lifted Q1 FY26 to 15.2%. So Q1 advertising cost probably did not jump back, even though the FY27 plan talks of 'continued ad investment'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY26: the ad-spend cut drove the 2.4x profit jump and the stock still fell about 9.9%.
findings.why_not_priced: An inference from absence. The full-year plan (OP margin 20.9% vs 21.4%) signals more marketing spend, so the street may model a weak Q1 margin; if ad cost stayed flat, Q1 margin holds near 15% or above. The global app launch on 2026-08-06 is a cost that cuts against this.
findings.independence: Earlier TV CM releases (https://jp.weathernews.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/20240610_tvcm.pdf), plus kabutan 2025-10-08 confirming the advertising-cost cut in Q1 FY26. Same company, different documents.

findings.finding: Reaction function and positioning: margin longs outnumber margin shorts 6.21 to 1. The last Q1 print, a kabutan-flagged surprise (ordinary profit 2.4x), was sold about 9.9% on 'bad news is out'. Without a shareholder-return announcement, recent prints (FY26 full year, -4.3%) were sold. The positive reactions (H1 FY26 sharp rally, Q3 FY26 up) came with dividend increases.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-09 -9.9% (Q1 beat, no returns); 2025-12-29 sharp rally (H1 plus a 100%-payout commemorative dividend); 2026-04-07 up three days running (Q3 plus a dividend revision); 2026-07-10 large drop (FY guide +3%). kabutan: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4825&nmode=0&date=20251200 and https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4825&nmode=0&date=20260400
findings.why_not_priced: The margin overhang sits in the baseline's priced_lean (-0.40) and is offset there by squeeze and run-up terms, so it is partly priced. What is not in the lean is the name's own pattern of selling Q1 beats that carry no capital-return news. Against it: a 20-day run-up of -4.3% means less profit to take than last October.
findings.independence: Margin ratio from the kabutan quote page (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4825) and from the baseline's separate scrape.

findings.finding: Mid-Term Vision 2026 (July) and its 2026-08-26 supplement commit to 'accelerating growth investment and shareholder returns', and say returns will be considered if marketing efficiency disappoints. That rests on 18.8bn yen of cash (67% of assets) and an 84.5% equity ratio, with a FY27 dividend of 50 yen (58% payout). A buyback or dividend change in the same TDnet batch is possible, but the company's recent returns came at H1 and Q3, not Q1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 FY26 2025-12-26: commemorative dividend with a 100% payout guide, then a sharp rally on 12-29 (kabutan). Q3 FY26 2026-04-06: dividend revision, then up three sessions running.
findings.why_not_priced: This is an option, not an announced fact: maybe 10-15% likely at a Q1 print, worth +4-5% if it comes. The expected-value size is what is filed. A price that held it would carry a premium into the print; instead the stock sits at a 20-day low.
findings.independence: FY26 tanshin outlook: 'from accumulation to circulation: accelerate growth investment and returns' (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260708589783.pdf). Same company, same plan.

outside_window.finding: A full-year upward revision is more likely at the H1 print (late December) than now: the company revised at H1 and Q3 in FY26, while its last Q1 revision was 2024-10-04. With FX about 9 yen weaker than the plan's 150 and record DAU, an H1 revision is plausible.

searched_and_found_nothing: Event date and time: confirmed 2026/10/08 on kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4825). No date change, and no 業績予想の修正 or 配当予想の修正 filed since 2026-07-09 (kabutan news list pages 1-5).
Shared Research sponsored report (https://sharedresearch.jp/ja/companies/4825): only the overview was reachable; nothing on Q1.
A quarterly consensus or a 会社四季報 Q1 number: none found.
A summer 2026 TV commercial: none found in company releases.
minkabu and Yahoo boards: not tried, because the hunter definition records minkabu as blocked.
Company IR host: not needed, because TDnet PDFs via kabutan answered.
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: unlikely at Q1 (no Q1 revision in FY26; last one 2024-10-04); plan 5,400 OP vs IFIS 5,656, so the street is already above the plan. Returns: possible, low probability; past returns came at H1/Q3. New-year guide: n/a (Q1). Quarter vs own progress rate: Q1 OP / FY was 10.1% in FY25 and 17.4% in FY26; I expect about 19% (OP ~1,000-1,100m) on DAU, FX and flat ad cost.

rejected_candidates.candidate: The global app reached No.1 in the weather category in 6 countries within 2 weeks of launch
rejected_candidates.detail: Same document as the DAU finding. The global launch is a cost in Q1 and a revenue item later, so it is folded into findings 1 and 3.

rejected_candidates.candidate: The 8/26 plan to reach a gross margin above 60%, with OP margin held at about 20%
rejected_candidates.detail: Folded into the capital-return finding (same document). The 3-year margin target resolves after the window.

baseline_tension: The fundamental evidence (record DAU, weak yen) leans positive and agrees with the mildly positive priced lean (+0.21) and the short covering. The name's history of selling Q1 beats and its 6.21x margin-long overhang cut against it. The strongest positive the release could carry is a buyback or dividend change; I looked, found commitment language but no Q1 precedent, and sized it as a low-probability option.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rule 1 governs negatives built on public series, and this hunt's one negative is reaction history and positioning, not a 月次 or progress-rate miss. The public DAU positive was already sized small for being public before the file was read. Rule 2's check (write the strongest positive into baseline_tension) was already done, with the capital-return search.
